entities.summary: Jan Rembowski was a Polish Symbolist painter, pastelist and sculptor. He was also associated with Art Nouveau. Jan Rembowski was a painters & sculptors from Wawrzyszew (1879-01-12, Wawrzyszew–1923-01-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
